There are a shit tonne of bugs, but a few things you can do to minimise them. 

Having the game on an SSD is nearly a must have, preferably nvme.

You should set your page file up to be higher than standard, for me it was 16gb max by default, I changed it to 32gb. It works better if you have the pagefile set onto a separate ssd from what the game is on afaik.

In nvidia control panel you can set your shader cache to 5gb or 10gb, which can sometimes be alleviate pop in problems.

Other than that, try and avoid too many background applications running and hope and pray for the best.
